svg.title: AWS Multi-Service DevOps Project network and application architecture
svg.desc: Planned architecture: Internet users, Route 53, Internet gateway, ALB in public subnets, NAT gateways, EC2 with Nginx in private app subnets across two AZs with Auto Scaling and EBS, RDS MySQL in private DB subnets, and S3.
svg.text: AWS Multi-Service DevOps Project – Cloud Architecture
Planned Architecture | AWS | Linux | Networking | Security | Monitoring
Private route tables: 0.0.0.0/0 to NAT in same AZ
